يقتصرا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَصِرَا (yaqtaṣirā) /jaq.ta.sˤi.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# يُقْتَصَرَا (yuqtaṣarā) /juq.ta.sˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
